# A Makefile exercising the lexer's rules. include config.mk -include optional.mk PREFIX ?= /usr/local CC := gcc CFLAGS += -Wall -O2 SOURCES = $(wildcard src/*.c) OBJECTS = $(patsubst src/%.c,build/%.o,$(SOURCES)) VERSION := $(shell git describe --tags 2>/dev/null) HEADERS = $(filter-out src/internal.h,$(wildcard src/*.h)) SUBDIRS = $(shell (cd src && ls -d */)) RENAMED = $(subst {old},{new},$(HEADERS)) QUOTED = "a string" SINGLE = 'another string' $(warning (nested) build check) export PATH export BUILD_DIR = build ifdef DEBUG CFLAGS += -g else CFLAGS += -DNDEBUG endif ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT) EXT = .exe endif .PHONY: all clean install test all: $(OBJECTS) @echo "building $(VERSION)" $(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o app$(EXT) $(OBJECTS) build/%.o: src/%.c $(HEADERS) @mkdir -p $(dir $@) $(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@ test: all ./app --self-test && echo "ok" install: all install -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin install -m 0755 app $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin/ clean: rm -rf build app$(EXT) define GREETING hello from make endef
